units.source_text: 这腼腆的花丛，实在太好了。

en.t: This shy-looking cluster of flowers was truly lovely.

units.source_text: 但是，木兰、绯樱、紫云英这类刺目的花儿，一旦盛开，就像大都会似的，使人眼花缭乱。

en.t: But dazzling flowers such as magnolias, scarlet cherry blossoms, and Chinese milk vetch, once in full bloom, were like a great city, bewildering the eye.

units.source_text: 此时他也想踏足深山的石谷，去寻觅款冬花了。

en.t: At that moment, he too felt like stepping into the stony valleys deep in the mountains to search for butterbur shoots.
